lines.text: Can you take one more task?

data.define: Used to say you can't take more work.

misuse.text: Don't say 'my plate is full' at dinner.
misuse.why: It means too many tasks, not food.

hook.text: Can you take one more task?

publish.title: What does "my plate is full" mean?
publish.value: My plate is full = My schedule is full. Example: "Sorry, my plate is full." (casual English).
